selected.title: NASA is due to share an update on its next Moon missions
selected.summary: NASA scheduled an October 23 briefing on Artemis plans, including upcoming missions and lunar lander preparations.
selected.why_it_matters: The details could affect mission timelines, commercial partners and when astronauts return to the Moon.
selected.challenge_question: Which spacecraft is NASA’s crew capsule for Artemis missions?
selected.answer_explanation: NASA identifies Orion as the crew capsule for Artemis missions. The October 23 briefing was scheduled to discuss plans; its outcome is not assumed here.
selected.butterfly_question: How might a change in Moon-mission plans reshape the race to build a lasting lunar presence?
